new_exact_v1_reviews.title: RateQuant: Optimal Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization via Rate-Distortion Theory
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Large language models cache all previously computed key-value (KV) pairs during generation, and this KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, making it a primary memory bottleneck for serving.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: Large language models cache all previously computed key-value (KV) pairs during generation, and this KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, making it a primary memory bottleneck for serving.
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: We present RateQuant , a framework that formalizes per-head KV cache bit allocation as rate-distortion optimization.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: We show, however, that such mixed-precision allocation has a hidden pitfall: each quantizer follows a different distortion curve D(b)=alpha*beta^{-b}, and the decay rate beta varies from 3.6 to 5.3 across quantizer designs.
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: We call this failure mode distortion model mismatch and propose RateQuant to resolve it.
new_exact_v1_reviews.coexistence_boundary: The older path remains appropriate where its workload and SLO do not trigger the changed constraint; the paper is treated as a conditional branch, not a universal replacement.

new_exact_v1_reviews.title: LKV: End-to-End Learning of Head-wise Budgets and Token Selection for LLM KV Cache Eviction
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Long-context inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache memory.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: Long-context inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache memory.
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: To address this limitation, we introduce LKV (Learned KV Eviction), which formulates KV compression as an end-to-end differentiable optimization problem.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LKV achieves state-of-the-art performance on both LongBench and RULER benchmarks at high compression rates.
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: To address this limitation, we introduce LKV (Learned KV Eviction), which formulates KV compression as an end-to-end differentiable optimization problem.
new_exact_v1_reviews.coexistence_boundary: The older path remains appropriate where its workload and SLO do not trigger the changed constraint; the paper is treated as a conditional branch, not a universal replacement.
